title: Birth in Sherman, Texas, and his farmer father
summary: Tate gives his birth date and place, his parents' origins, his father's three farms and early death, and being raised by older siblings.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Tell me about your folks. Where were they born?

Well, I think they all are from -- my mother was -- I think she was raised in Oklahoma, but on my dad's side, they're all from Texas, a little town that's called Polly Grove , Texas, a small place. It's between Dallas and Sherman.

Of course, I was born in Sherman, Texas. He came to Sherman, Texas, along with his father and he was a farmer and he was very successful. He died very early. I was only two years old when he passed, but he had owned three farms and he was only 46 and I kind of admired him for that, you know, because he must have paid some dues to own three farms.

So, you know, I was raised without a father, but I had two brothers that were older. One was ten years older and one was eight years older and the sister was like seven years older. So that makes quite a difference, you know, like when
They kind of helped bring you up.
